items.difficulty_reason: Exactness of a sequence of abelian sheaves on a stack checked after pulling back to a covering: for x over T the sequence of restrictions x^{-1}F -> x^{-1}G -> x^{-1}H is the target; the hypothesis supplies a tau-covering {T_i -> T} with x|_{T_i} isomorphic to f(u_i) and exactness of the u_i^{-1}f^{-1} sequence, and since u_i^{-1}f^{-1}F = x^{-1}F restricted to (Sch/T_i)_tau exactness localises. Retained author proof at lines 3539-3555.
